build_TransformerModel: build a transformer encoder-decoder model using TransformerModel.build_model with a fairseq task and args
build_TransformerEncoder: build a transformer encoder with configurable layers and attention heads using TransformerEncoder
build_TransformerDecoder: build a transformer decoder with incremental state support using TransformerDecoder
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the transformer model with source tokens and previous output tokens
configure_transformer_architecture: configure a transformer architecture using base_architecture or tiny_architecture with custom hyperparameters
